data.reason: product Clean now also includes the verified CC-BY EG-IPT raw-DI subset (4.730397 hours), the CC-BY Longitudinal Guitar String Ageing raw-DI corpus (10.746655 hours), and two low-weight CC0 sampled instruments. Real-performance Clean is about 25.25 hours, so the hour minimum is closed, but the longitudinal source repeats one fixed routine over 28 days and only about seven clearly independent real-performance players are represented. Player diversity and multi-effect overlap coverage still block retraining; sampled-note hours do not close either gate
